cases.name: Charity Lynn Perry
cases.about: Members of her family spoke with KATU News, saying they want Perry to be remembered for her kindness and to raise awareness for the mental health challenges she faced before she died. "She always had a smile that could light up the world," said Diana Allen, Perry's mother. "She was an amazing person," said Star Carr, Perry's cousin.
cases.narrative: On 4/24/2023, her body was found near Ainsworth State Park along the Columbia River Gorge in Multnomah County, OR.
